consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1994-03-16 show at Rosemont Horizon was a standout performance for the year, featuring several highlights despite some criticisms of the sound quality and certain song choices. The show is remembered for its strong setlist, including a rare Dark Star, and notable performances of High Time and Scarlet>Fire.
